description: EVM-007 AC1, AC3 (ADR-0018 V4; plan P4, architect 3): the fixed list of infrastructure images of the VM, by tag + digest. Installed only in an IaC session (compose.infra.yaml); scanned with the release images in the publish job (bramka 6). Every digest is the multi-arch index (not a single-platform manifest) and the index contains the platform below (the Arm64 VM, Hetzner CAX; checked against the registry 2026-10-21): clamav/clamav (Alpine) is amd64-only, so ClamAV comes from clamav/clamav-debian (amd64, arm64, ppc64le).
